product_metadata.title: Taco Holder Stand Set of 6, Colorful Taco Holder Plate, Wave Shape Taco Tray, Taco Shell Holder Stand for Party, Hold 4 Tacos Each, Very Hard and Sturdy, Dishwasher Top Rack Safe
features: Taco Holder Stand: Taco stand is made of high-quality food-grade ABS, 6 pack taco holder stand with 6 colors. This taco stand holds 4 tacos each, easy to clean.

Multifunction Taco Holder: Great for holding hard-shelled tacos, soft shell, small tortilla, sandwiches, hot dog buns, sausages and other food. Ideal for a use when family gatherings, parties, picnics, barbecues, etc.
Safe & Sturdy: Our taco stand crafted with high-grade ABS material. BPA free, Dishwasher-safe, Break-Resistant, much harder and more sturdy.
Wave Shape: One taco holder size is 6.9'' x 2.2'' x 1.2''. It has the unique wave shape, which makes it easier to place the pancake and keep it upright and in a good shape.
Space Saving: Multiple taco holders can be stacked without taking up too much space.
